560-2457-4289-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

728-1659-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-5470-7730-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2738-4871-7316.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

275-341-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Umori.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2067-2584.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Pandemonium triggers that many times, dealing that much damage divided among any target(s)

1510-2921-4574-5849.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

1943-2034-2068-2626.description:
Activate Snake Basket by paying {4} and sacrificing it.
Ashnod triggers, copying Snake Basket's ability.
Resolve both Snake Basket abilities, creating eight 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, targeting Snake Basket.
Ashnod triggers, copying Salvager of Ruin's ability, targeting Salvager of Ruin.
Resolve both Salvager of Ruin abilities, returning Salvager of Ruin and Snake Basket from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing six Snakes, adding twelve {C}.
Cast Salvager of Ruin by paying {3}.
Cast Snake Basket by paying {4}.
Repeat.

67-1676-4050-6917.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reveillark, adding {B}.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur, adding {G}.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Citizens, adding {3}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
67-1676-4050-6917.notes: You must control two additional creatures to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-4853-5256.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2544-5149-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2544-5149-6788.description:
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2544-5149-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1722-2034-5780-6625.description:
Cast Nadir Kraken by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Nadir Kraken enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat from step 5.
1722-2034-5780-6625.notes: You can skip the sacrifice in step 7 if you have mana available.

3560-4050-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-4050-5972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2634-2997-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2634-2997-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1692-5226-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-5226-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-5226-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

3197-5783-5784.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token that has flying and vigilance due to Aven Wind Guide.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

751-3168-4875-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Conspiracy.
751-3168-4875-5613.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {0}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Azusa's Many Journeys // Likeness of the Seeker

539-5503-5504-5505.notablePrerequisites:
Likeness of the Seeker and Balduvian Warlord do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature that can block Likeness of the Seeker.
539-5503-5504-5505.description:
Cast Irresistible Prey by paying {G}, targeting Likeness of the Seeker.
Declare Likeness of the Seeker as an attacker, forcing an opponent to block it.
Likeness of the Seeker triggers, untapping Balduvian Warlord and two other lands you control.
Optionally, you may activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Balduvian Warlord by tapping it, removing a creature blocking Likeness of the Seeker from combat, and then causing that creature to block Likeness of the Seeker.
Repeat from step 3.

757-2003-4221-5087.notablePrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
757-2003-4221-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Contagion Engine by paying {6} and tapping it, putting two eon counters on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, putting two eon counters on Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

2541-4997.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2541-4997.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: You must have a way to stop this combo, otherwise you will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

468-1399-2681-3814.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
468-1399-2681-3814.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {G}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {B}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Cast Massacre Wurm by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}.
When Massacre Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing each opposing creature to get -2/-2 until end of turn.
Each Spirit token your opponents control dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.
Massacre Wurm's second ability triggers for each Spirit that dies this way, causing each opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life and lose the game.

803-2300-3510-3875.notablePrerequisites:
"Saproling" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have a land card in hand, and are able to play a land this turn.
803-2300-3510-3875.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
The Food or Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling artifact creature that is also a Forest land due to Titania's Song, Life and Limb, and Arcane Adaptation.
Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

313-570-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Faeburrow Elder, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Faeburrow Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {W}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

461-1642-4141.notablePrerequisites:
You control an untapped Vampire.
Warlock Class is level three.
461-1642-4141.description:
Activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to copy the next spell you cast this turn that targets a single opponent for each other opponent.
Cast Blood Tribute with kicker by paying {4}{B}{B} and tapping a Vampire you control, targeting any opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

933-1367-4628.notablePrerequisites: Kaho does not have summoning sickness.
933-1367-4628.description:
Activate Kaho by paying {7} and tapping it, casting Nexus of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Kaho.
Kaho enters the battlefield, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.

23-776-1329-3092.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-3092.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Orochi Hatchery to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Orochi Hatchery.
Cast Orochi Hatchery.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-3977-4456.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Horned Kavu.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Return Horned Kavu to hand using its ability.
